definition_en: cotton yarn that has been combed to remove short fibers, producing a smoother, stronger, cleaner yarn
definition_zh: 精梳棉纱（去除短纤后强力高、毛羽少）
example_en: All T-shirts under this PO must use 100% combed yarn.
example_zh: 此订单下所有 T 恤必须使用 100% 精梳棉纱。

definition_en: cotton yarn that has only been carded, leaving more short fibers and a rougher surface
definition_zh: 普梳棉纱（成本低，毛羽较多）
example_en: Carded yarn is acceptable for the inner pocket lining only.
example_zh: 普梳棉仅可用于内袋里布。

definition_en: yarn produced by ring spinning, the most common method that gives good strength and soft hand feel
definition_zh: 环锭纺纱（最主流的纺纱方式）
example_en: Please confirm the yarn is 32s ring spun, not open-end.
example_zh: 请确认纱线为 32 支环锭纺，非气流纺。

definition_en: yarn spun on a compact spinning frame, with very low hairiness and high luster
definition_zh: 紧密纺纱（毛羽少、强力高、光洁）
example_en: Compact yarn is mandatory for our premium shirting.
example_zh: 高档衬衫面料必须使用紧密纺纱。

definition_en: yarn produced by rotor spinning, lower cost but rougher hand feel and lower strength
definition_zh: 气流纺纱（成本低、手感粗硬）
example_en: Open-end yarn is fine for low-end fleece.
example_zh: 气流纺可用于低端摇粒绒。

definition_en: yarn with intentional thick-and-thin variations for a textured, linen-look fabric
definition_zh: 竹节纱（粗细不匀的花式纱）
example_en: Please develop a slub yarn linen-look fabric for SS25.
example_zh: 请为 25 春夏开发一款仿亚麻竹节纱面料。

definition_en: yarn spun from a blend of pre-dyed fibers to give a heathered or snowflake effect
definition_zh: 麻灰纱（混色纱，呈现雪花效果）
example_en: Use grey melange yarn 80/20 cotton-polyester for the hoodie body.
example_zh: 卫衣身布采用 80/20 棉涤灰色麻灰纱。

definition_en: yarn with a filament core (usually spandex) wrapped by staple fibers, used for stretch fabrics
definition_zh: 包芯纱（长丝芯外包短纤，棉包氨纶常见）
example_en: The denim uses cotton core-spun yarn with a spandex core.
example_zh: 此牛仔布采用棉包氨纶的包芯纱织造。

definition_en: the linear density of yarn, expressed in Ne (English), Tex, denier (D) or Nm (metric)
example_en: Please specify the yarn count in both Ne and Tex.
example_zh: 请同时以英制和特数标注纱支。

definition_en: number of twists per meter of yarn, affects hand feel and strength
example_en: The hard-twisted voile requires 1,200 TPM.
example_zh: 强捻巴厘纱要求每米 1200 捻。

definition_en: the standard right-hand twist direction in cotton yarn
definition_zh: Z 捻（右捻，棉纺单纱最常用）
example_en: Single yarns are normally Z-twist in the cotton system.
example_zh: 棉纺单纱通常为 Z 捻。

definition_en: coefficient of variation of yarn evenness measured on a Uster tester, lower is better
definition_zh: 条干变异系数（越小越均匀）
example_en: Uster CV% should not exceed 13.5 for 30s combed cotton.
example_zh: 30 支精梳棉的 Uster CV% 不应超过 13.5。

definition_en: total count of thick places, thin places and neps per kilometer of yarn
definition_zh: 千米疵点（粗节+细节+棉结总数）
example_en: The buyer requires IPI below 150 per km for shirting yarn.
example_zh: 客户要求衬衫纱 IPI 低于 150/km。

definition_en: the H value from Uster tester measuring protruding fibers on yarn surface
example_en: The Uster hairiness index H must be below 5.5.
example_zh: Uster 毛羽指数 H 必须低于 5.5。

definition_en: specific strength of yarn in cN/tex (centinewtons per tex)
example_en: The tenacity of this combed cotton yarn is 18 cN/tex.
example_zh: 此精梳棉纱的比强力为 18 cN/tex。

definition_en: number of warp yarns per inch in woven fabric
example_en: EPI 110, PPI 76, balanced plain weave for the poplin order.
example_zh: 经密 110、纬密 76，平衡平纹用于府绸订单。

definition_en: number of weft yarns per inch in woven fabric
example_en: PPI above 80 may cause reed mark on this yarn count.
example_zh: 该纱支纬密超过 80 可能产生筘痕。

definition_en: the usable width of finished fabric for garment lay planning
example_en: Cuttable width 58/60 inches, please plan marker accordingly.
example_zh: 可裁门幅 58/60 英寸，请按此排料。

definition_en: a balanced plain-weave shirting fabric, typically 110x76 EPI/PPI
example_en: 110x76 poplin, 100% cotton, 110 GSM, cuttable width 58/60 inches.
example_zh: 110x76 府绸，全棉，110 克重，可裁门幅 58/60 英寸。

definition_en: a sturdy 3/1 twill fabric, usually indigo-dyed warp and natural weft
definition_zh: 牛仔布（3/1 斜纹，靛蓝经+本白纬）
example_en: 12 oz indigo denim, 3/1 twill, sanforized, shrinkage under 3%.
example_zh: 12 盎司靛蓝牛仔，3/1 斜纹，预缩缩水率 3% 以内。

definition_en: a weave structure with diagonal lines, e.g. 2/1 twill, 3/1 twill
example_en: 2/1 twill, combed cotton, suitable for workwear trousers.
example_zh: 2/1 斜纹，精梳棉，适合工装裤。

definition_en: a shuttleless loom using rigid or flexible rapiers to insert weft, ideal for high-quality poplin
definition_zh: 剑杆织机（适合高密府绸）
example_en: We use Picanol rapier looms for solid poplin; no weft streaks.
example_zh: 我们用必佳乐剑杆织机织素色府绸，无纬档。

definition_en: a shuttleless loom using air jets to insert weft, high speed for mass production
definition_zh: 喷气织机（适合大批量雪纺等薄型）
example_en: Air-jet loom is the best option for mass production of chiffon.
example_zh: 喷气织机是雪纺大批量生产的最佳选择。

definition_en: a basic warp-knit fabric, smooth on both sides, used for lingerie and linings
example_en: 40D tricot, 60 GSM, widely used for lingerie and linings.
example_zh: 40D 经编平针，60 克重，广泛用于内衣和里布。

definition_en: a warp-knit machine/structure capable of complex laces and meshes
definition_zh: 拉舍尔经编（蕾丝与网眼）
example_en: Raschel lace, 150 cm width, 4-bar, for women's dresses.
example_zh: 拉舍尔蕾丝，门幅 150 厘米，4 梳，用于女裙。

definition_en: a basic weft-knit fabric with one side smooth, one side looped, used for T-shirts
definition_zh: 单面布（汗布，T 恤常用）
example_en: 30s single jersey, 160 GSM, 100% cotton, for basic tees.
example_zh: 30 支单面布，160 克重，全棉，用于基础 T 恤。

definition_en: a double-knit fabric with two-faced structure, more stable than single jersey
definition_zh: 双罗纹/棉毛布（更厚实稳定）
example_en: 40s interlock, 200 GSM, used for premium polo shirts.
example_zh: 40 支双罗纹，200 克重，用于高档 Polo 衫。

definition_en: a knit fabric with a textured waffle or honeycomb surface, classic for polo shirts
definition_zh: 珠地布（Polo 衫经典面料）
example_en: Lacoste piqué, 220 GSM, 100% cotton, for polo shirts.
example_zh: 拉科斯特珠地布，220 克重，全棉，用作 Polo 衫。

definition_en: a one-piece knitted shoe upper produced on computer flat knitting machines
definition_zh: 飞织鞋面（电脑横机一体编织）
example_en: Flyknit upper is the new standard for running shoes.
example_zh: 飞织鞋面是跑鞋的新标准。

definition_en: a knitting technique that creates color blocks without extra yarn on the back
definition_zh: 嵌花（色块拼接，背面无浮线）
example_en: Intarsia is used for color blocks without extra yarn on the back.
example_zh: 嵌花用于色块拼接，背面没有多余纱线。

definition_en: visible horizontal streaks in woven or knitted fabric caused by uneven yarn or tension
definition_zh: 纬档（条干不匀引起的横条）
example_en: Barre was found on the 3rd lot; please re-reed the loom.
example_zh: 第三批发现纬档，请重新穿筘。

definition_en: the needle density of a knitting machine, e.g. E14, E18, E24, higher is finer
definition_zh: 针织机号（数字越大针越细）
example_en: 12-gauge gives a chunky sweater, 16-gauge is mid-weight.
example_zh: 12 针机号织粗针毛衫，16 针为中厚。

definition_en: a class of dye that forms covalent bonds with cellulose fibers, used on cotton
definition_zh: 活性染料（纤维素纤维常用）
example_en: Please use reactive dyes for this 100% cotton jersey.
example_zh: 这款 100% 棉针织请使用活性染料。

definition_en: a class of dye used on polyester and other synthetic fibers, applied via thermosol
example_en: For polyester chiffon, disperse dyes with thermosol process are recommended.
example_zh: 涤纶雪纺建议采用分散染料热溶工艺。

definition_en: a class of dye with excellent fastness, used on denim and workwear
definition_zh: 还原染料（牛仔/工装常用）
example_en: Vat dyes give the denim excellent light and wash fastness.
example_zh: 还原染料使牛仔布具有优异的耐光和水洗牢度。

definition_en: dyeing performed on finished garments for a softer hand feel and vintage look
example_en: The customer prefers garment dye to get a softer hand feel.
example_zh: 客户偏好成衣染色以获得更柔软的手感。

definition_en: an overflow dyeing machine that circulates fabric in a rope form, common for knits
example_en: Please use jet dyeing machines to avoid creases on this polyester knit.
example_zh: 请用溢流机染色以避免此款涤纶针织起皱。

definition_en: a continuous disperse dyeing process using 200-220°C dry heat fixation on polyester
definition_zh: 热溶染色（涤纶连续染色）
example_en: Thermosol process requires 200-220°C dry heat fixation.
example_zh: 热溶工艺需 200-220°C 干热固色。

definition_en: a small sample of fabric dyed in the lab to confirm shade before bulk production
example_en: We need 3 lab dips per color for customer approval.
example_zh: 每个颜色需打 3 个小样供客户确认。

definition_en: Pantone textile color standard on paper, used for color matching
example_en: Please match the lab dip against Pantone TPX 19-3950.
example_zh: 请按潘通 TPX 19-3950 打小样。

definition_en: Pantone textile color standard on cotton substrate, latest generation
definition_zh: 潘通纺织色卡（棉版/新版）
example_en: Pantone TCX is the latest cotton-based color standard.
example_zh: Pantone TCX 是最新的棉版色卡标准。

definition_en: a numeric value representing the perceived color difference between two samples, lower is closer
definition_zh: 色差值 ΔE（越小越接近）
example_en: Delta E must be less than 1.0 between bulk and approved sample.
example_zh: 大货与确认样 ΔE 必须小于 1.0。

definition_en: the resistance of a dyed fabric to fading or bleeding under various conditions
example_en: Color fastness to washing must be grade 4 or above.
example_zh: 水洗牢度必须 4 级及以上。

definition_en: two colors appear to match under one light source but differ under another
definition_zh: 同色异谱（不同光源下显色差异）
example_en: Please check metamerism under CWF and D65 light sources.
example_zh: 请在 CWF 和 D65 光源下检查同色异谱现象。

definition_en: the international standard daylight illuminant at 6500K used for color assessment
definition_zh: D65 标准光源（6500K 日光）
example_en: Color matching is done under D65 light source.
example_zh: 配色需在 D65 光源下进行。

definition_en: treating cotton with concentrated caustic soda to add luster and improve dye uptake
example_en: Mercerized cotton has a silk-like luster.
example_zh: 丝光棉具有丝绸般光泽。

definition_en: a mechanical pre-shrinking process that limits residual shrinkage to under 3%
example_en: Sanforized denim is standard for premium jeans brands.
example_zh: 高端牛仔品牌牛仔布必须做桑福整理。

definition_en: a water-repellent finish that causes water to bead on the fabric surface
example_en: The DWR coating must pass 20 wash cycles.
example_zh: DWR 涂层须耐 20 次水洗。

definition_en: the percentage reduction in fabric weight after wet processing, normally under 5%
definition_zh: 克重损失（染整后克重减少比例）
example_en: GSM loss after dyeing must be under 5%.
example_zh: 染整后克重损失须在 5% 以内。

definition_en: a sample made from bulk fabric and trims before bulk production starts
definition_zh: 大货前样（量产前确认样）
example_en: PP sample must be approved before bulk production starts.
example_zh: 大货生产开始前必须先批核大货前样。

definition_en: a sample taken from the bulk production run for final approval before shipment
example_en: TOP sample is approved; please proceed with bulk cutting.
example_zh: 尾期样已批，请开始大货裁剪。

definition_en: a complete set of garment specifications including measurements, construction and materials
example_en: Please confirm the tech pack before sampling.
example_zh: 打样前请确认工艺单。

definition_en: a paper or digital lay plan that maximizes fabric utilization
example_en: The marker length is 4.8m with 92% fabric utilization.
example_zh: 排料图长 4.8 米，面料利用率 92%。

definition_en: the number of stitches per inch in a seam, higher means finer and stronger
example_en: Use SPI 12 for the side seam on woven shirts.
example_zh: 梭织衬衫侧缝用 SPI 12。

definition_en: a stitch type that lays flat against the skin, common in sportswear
example_en: Flatlock seams are mandatory for next-to-skin garments.
example_zh: 贴身服装必须使用绷缝线迹。

definition_en: the standard sewing machine stitch, ISO 301, used for most structural seams
example_en: Use lockstitch 301 for the main structural seams.
example_zh: 主要结构缝使用 301 锁式线迹。

definition_en: a stitch that wraps the raw edge to prevent fraying, ISO 504
example_en: All raw edges must be overlocked with 504.
example_zh: 所有毛边需用 504 包缝。

definition_en: the process of bonding interlining to garment components using heat and pressure
example_en: Pre-shrink the interlining before fusing to avoid shrinkage.
example_zh: 粘合前先预缩衬布。

definition_en: production of garments under the buyer's brand and design
example_en: We accept OEM orders with your brand label.
example_zh: 我们接受带贵司品牌的贴牌订单。

definition_en: production based on the factory's own design, branded by the buyer
example_en: Our ODM team can develop new styles based on your brief.
example_zh: 我们的 ODM 团队可根据简报开发新款式。

definition_en: converting artwork into stitch files (DST, EMB) for machine embroidery
example_en: Embroidery digitizing costs US$25 per design.
example_zh: 每个图案的绣花打版费为 25 美元。

definition_en: the standard digital file format for Tajima embroidery machines
example_en: Could you resend the DST file? The previous one is corrupted.
example_zh: 请重新发送 DST 文件，之前那份已损坏。

definition_en: a dense zigzag stitch used for small letters and outlines under 5mm
example_en: Use satin stitch for any text under 5 mm height.
example_zh: 所有 5 毫米以下的文字请用包针。

definition_en: a 3D looped embroidery effect, often used for letterman patches
example_en: Chenille embroidery gives a 3D looped effect on the cuff.
example_zh: 绳绣在袖口呈现立体环状效果。

definition_en: a decorative technique that sews fabric pieces onto a base fabric
example_en: The logo is done by appliqué with merrowed edge.
example_zh: 标志采用贴布绣配包边针处理。

definition_en: a printing method using mesh screens, one color per screen
example_en: We specialize in screen printing up to 12 colors.
example_zh: 我司专做 12 色以内的丝网印花。

definition_en: direct-to-garment digital printing, best for small batches and full-color designs
example_en: DTG printing works best on 100% cotton T-shirts.
example_zh: 数码直喷在 100% 棉 T 恤上效果最佳。

definition_en: a heat-transfer print method for polyester, dyes turn into gas and bond with fibers
example_en: Sublimation printing requires polyester-rich fabric.
example_zh: 升华印花需含涤面料以呈现鲜艳色彩。

definition_en: printing that bleaches out the background dye and replaces it with new color
example_en: Discharge printing on dark ground requires a sample approval first.
example_zh: 深底拔染印花需先批色样。

definition_en: a garment wash using cellulase enzymes to soften fabric and create a vintage look
example_en: Enzyme wash is more eco-friendly than traditional stone wash.
example_zh: 酵素水洗比传统石头水洗更环保。

definition_en: a garment wash using pumice stones to abrade denim for a worn look
example_en: Stone wash for 30 minutes gives the denim a vintage look.
example_zh: 石头水洗 30 分钟让牛仔呈现复古效果。

definition_en: the percentage change in fabric dimensions after washing
example_en: Dimensional change must stay within 3% both directions.
example_zh: 经纬向尺寸变化均须在 3% 以内。

definition_en: a wrap-stitched edge used on patches and twill numbers to prevent fray
example_en: Merrowed edge wraps the twill border to lock all threads.
example_zh: 包边缝将斜纹布四周包住以锁线。

definition_en: the statistical sampling threshold for inspection, e.g. AQL 2.5 general level II
example_en: Most sportswear buyers use AQL 2.5 for general inspection.
example_zh: 大多数运动服装客户按 AQL 2.5 验货。

definition_en: the final random inspection on finished goods before shipment
example_en: A third-party PSI is required before we can release the goods.
example_zh: 装运前必须经第三方 PSI 检验才能放货。

definition_en: an inspection done when 30-40% of the order is finished to catch issues early
example_en: We suggest a DPI when 30% of the order is finished.
example_zh: 建议订单完成 30% 时做一次 DPI 检验。

definition_en: a formal inquiry sent to suppliers asking for price quotation
example_en: We received an RFQ for 10,000 pcs of running T-shirts.
example_zh: 我们收到一万件跑步 T 恤的询价单。

definition_en: a preliminary invoice used as a quotation and payment reference before shipment
example_en: Please issue the PI so we can arrange the deposit.
example_zh: 请开出形式发票以便我方安排定金。

definition_en: a bank-issued payment guarantee tied to shipping document compliance
example_en: The L/C must be opened 30 days before the shipment date.
example_zh: 信用证须在装运日前 30 天开立。

definition_en: a legal document issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo
example_en: Please send us 3 originals and 3 copies of the B/L.
example_zh: 请提供 3 正 3 副的海运提单。

definition_en: the international customs classification code for goods
example_en: For yoga leggings, the HS code is 6104.43 in most markets.
example_zh: 瑜伽裤在大多数市场的 HS 编码是 6104.43。

definition_en: an Incoterm where the seller delivers goods on board the vessel at the port of shipment
example_en: Quote on FOB Shanghai basis for 5,000 pcs.
example_zh: 5000 件请报 FOB 上海价。

definition_en: an Incoterm where the seller pays cost, insurance and freight to the destination port
example_en: CIF Hamburg includes ocean freight and insurance.
example_zh: 汉堡 CIF 价包含海运费和保险费。

definition_en: a wire transfer payment method, common as 30% deposit + 70% balance
example_en: 30% T/T deposit and balance against B/L copy is our standard.
example_zh: 30% T/T 定金，余款凭提单复印件付清是标准。

definition_en: a document issued to deduct money from an invoice, typically for claims
example_en: We will issue a debit note to deduct the rework cost.
example_zh: 我方将开具借记通知扣减返工费。

definition_en: a document issued as a credit to the buyer for compensation or allowance
example_en: A credit note of US$1,200 has been issued for the late delivery.
example_zh: 因延迟出货已开具 1200 美元的贷记通知。

definition_en: compliance with the EU REACH regulation on chemicals, SVHC below 0.1%
example_en: All dyes must show REACH compliance for the EU market.
example_zh: 欧盟市场所有染料须符合 REACH。

definition_en: a defect that endangers the user (e.g. broken needle), zero acceptance
example_en: A broken needle left in the seam is a critical defect.
example_zh: 断针遗留在缝内属严重缺陷。

definition_en: a defect that reduces usability or saleability
example_en: Uneven dye shade on the front panel is a major defect.
example_zh: 前片染色不均按主要缺陷判定。

definition_en: a defect that does not affect usability but is below standard
example_en: A 2 cm loose thread on the hem is a minor defect.
example_zh: 下摆 2 厘米的散线属次要缺陷。

definition_en: a fabric finish that pulls sweat away from the skin for quick drying
example_en: All running tops must be moisture-wicking with a wicking rate ≥ 35 mm/10min.
example_zh: 所有跑步上衣必须具备排汗功能。

definition_en: fabric that stretches in both warp and weft directions
example_en: The fabric provides four-way stretch with 25% recovery after 5 washes.
example_zh: 该面料具备四面弹力，5 次水洗后回弹率达 25%。

definition_en: a leggings quality standard that ensures the fabric is opaque when squatting
example_en: All our leggings must be squat-proof at 250 GSM.
example_zh: 我司瑜伽裤在 250 GSM 下必须深蹲不透。

definition_en: a fabric rating that blocks 98% of UVA/UVB rays
example_en: The sun hoodie is rated UPF 50+ for outdoor training.
example_zh: 这款防晒连帽衫 UPF 达 50+。

definition_en: a waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane used in outdoor apparel
example_en: The trail-running jacket uses 3-layer Gore-Tex.
example_zh: 这款越野跑夹克采用 3 层 Gore-Tex。

definition_en: a premium synthetic insulation that retains warmth when wet
example_en: PrimaLoft Gold is the warmest synthetic fill in the line.
example_zh: PrimaLoft Gold 是系列中保暖最强的合成棉。

definition_en: a certification ensuring down is sourced responsibly with full chain of custody
example_en: The buyer requires the RDS certificate for every down order.
example_zh: 买方要求每张羽绒订单都附 RDS 证书。

definition_en: a measure of down loft, higher means warmer for the same weight
example_en: The fill power is 800, providing high warmth at low weight.
example_zh: 蓬松度 800，重量轻却保暖强。

definition_en: a die-cut twill number sewn onto jerseys, classic for NBA-style jerseys
example_en: Tackle twill numbers are stitched on with zigzag merrowed edge.
example_zh: 贴布绣号码用之字包边缝车缝固定。

definition_en: polyester fiber made from recycled PET bottles, GRS certified
example_en: Buyer requires GRS-certified recycled polyester for SS25.
example_zh: 买家要求 25 春夏系列采用 GRS 认证再生涤纶。

definition_en: a sleeveless running top with narrow shoulder straps
example_en: The running singlet weighs only 65 grams to maximize breathability.
example_zh: 跑步背心仅重 65 克以最大化透气性。

definition_en: tight-fitting leggings that apply graduated pressure for muscle support
example_en: The compression tights apply 18 mmHg pressure at the calf zone.
example_zh: 压缩紧身裤在小腿区域施加 18 mmHg 压力。

definition_en: high-waisted stretch leggings designed for yoga and athleisure
definition_zh: 瑜伽裤（高腰紧身打底裤）
example_en: Our SS27 yoga leggings come in 12 solid colors and 3 prints.
example_zh: 我方 27 春夏瑜伽裤有 12 个素色和 3 个印花可选。

definition_en: a waistband that sits at or above the natural waistline
example_en: The yoga leggings feature a high-waisted design.
example_zh: 瑜伽裤采用高腰设计，修饰身形。

definition_en: a waistband knitted in one piece to avoid digging into the skin
example_en: Seamless waistband is knitted in one piece to avoid digging in.
example_zh: 无缝腰头一体编织以避免勒肉。

definition_en: customized jerseys, shorts and socks made for a sports team
example_en: Our MOQ for full teamwear customization is 30 sets per design.
example_zh: 整套球服定制的起订量为每款 30 套。
